parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.item.json;
const folderUrl=d.drive_folder_url||'';
const folderId=d.sub_folder_id||'';
const skillName=String(d.skill_override||'').trim()||'carousel-to-linkedin';
const designBlock=skillName.toLowerCase()==='carousel-to-linkedin'
  ?'DESIGN SYSTEM (mandatory): Use The Innovation Imperative design system. Slides are 1080x1440px portrait HTML cards (min-height 1440px, 220px top + 120px left/right padding). Colors: background #0A0E27, cyan #00D9FF, magenta #FF1493, gold #FFB800, gray #A0A5C0. Typography: Inter - headline 90px/900, section tag 24px/700, body 28-36px/400, insight 42px/700, stat numbers 64-80px/900. Each slide: header (logo top-left 40px, magenta swipe arrow top-right), section tag with cyan left line, headline, content (2-4 items max), insight box (8px magenta left border), footer with page counter. Keep slide proportions consistent; max 2-4 content items per slide; no inline transform styles.

'
  :'DESIGN SYSTEM (mandatory): Use ONLY the design system defined in the '+skillName+' skill: its canvas size, colors, typography, illustration style and slide layout. Do NOT apply The Innovation Imperative design system or any design rules from outside that skill.

';
const msg='Create an AlfredAI LinkedIn carousel from the source post below, following your full end-to-end workflow (condense the content to avoid text overload, write the carousel slides, generate the LinkedIn caption in AlfredAI brand voice, and build cited data references).

SKILL LOCK (mandatory - read first): Use ONLY the '+skillName+' skill for every part of this task. Do NOT load, open, read, reference, or apply any other skill, including any LinkedIn post skill, any brand skill, any personal-scope skill, and any skill that looks relevant to the caption. The caption is produced by '+skillName+' itself. If you find yourself about to load a second skill, stop and continue with '+skillName+' only.

'+designBlock+'LOGO (mandatory - use the OFFICIAL AlfredAI logo): Use the official AlfredAI logo asset bundled in your skill (the composite logo / logo template that ships with the skill). Composite that exact asset onto the slides. Do NOT generate, redraw, recreate, or approximate the logo with an image model. Do NOT put any black box, dark rectangle, colored panel, or solid shape behind it - it is a transparent wordmark and the slide background must show through around the letters. If the logo asset appears low-contrast, the only allowed enhancement is a soft feathered glow, never a filled box.

Render the slides via Manus slide tools and export the carousel to PDF, then also export each slide as a PNG.

Source LinkedIn post (recreate from this):
'+d.source_url+'

PRE-SHIP QUALITY CHECK (mandatory - do this BEFORE uploading anything to Google Drive): Before you upload, review every slide and the caption and verify ALL of the following. Do NOT upload until every item passes; if any fails, fix it and re-render first.
1. TEXT CORRECTNESS: all text is accurate, spelled correctly, grammatically clean, and matches the source meaning. No placeholder text, no lorem ipsum, no cut-off words.
2. NO OVERLAP: no text overlaps other text, graphics, the logo, or slide edges. Everything sits inside the safe margins. Nothing is clipped or running off-canvas.
3. READABILITY: every text element is legible against its background with strong contrast. Font sizes match the design system. No text is too small or crowded.
4. GRAPHICS CORRECT: all graphics, icons, charts, colors, and the logo are correct, on-brand, not distorted, not duplicated, and relevant to the content. The AlfredAI logo is the official asset, transparent, with no box behind it.
5. LAYOUT: consistent alignment and spacing across slides; page counter correct; slide order logical.
6. COMPLETENESS: the correct number of slides, the PDF, and the caption are all present.
Only once every check passes, proceed to upload.

UPLOAD (MANDATORY - this is a required final step, do not skip it):
DESTINATION_FOLDER_ID: '+folderId+'
DESTINATION_FOLDER_URL: '+folderUrl+'

After the quality check passes, you MUST upload every final file (the carousel PDF and each slide PNG) to the user's Google Drive using rclone, targeting the EXISTING destination folder by its ID. Use the rclone flag --drive-root-folder-id '+folderId+' so the files land directly INSIDE that existing folder. The destination is a shared drive, so also include shared-drive support. Run the upload EXACTLY ONCE; do not re-run or duplicate. Do NOT create a new folder. Do NOT use the folder ID as a new folder name. Do NOT leave the files only in your task workspace - they must end up inside the existing Drive folder with ID '+folderId+'. After uploading, confirm in your task output the exact list of files you placed in that folder, and provide the LinkedIn caption and the cited references.';
return{json:{...d,manus_message:msg,destination_folder_id:folderId}};
